snippets.author: Jeff Thompson
snippets.text:
Great State Park.  First time visiting and loved it.  We had a rental cabin with an RV spot.  The cabin was a dry cabin with heat and AC.  The RV site was roomy and plenty of room to walk between the cabin and RV.  The site was right on the lake and the sunsets are amazing!

We explored the town and area for several days.  We went to Oatman, The Desert Bar and the Bunker Bar.  Did some paddle boarding as well.

We will visit again!

snippets.author: Shelly Kissinger
snippets.text: This is a great park.  The park is big, it has a section for cabins and one for RV's.   The park staff does a great job of keeping the park neat and clean.  They have some nice beach areas and even one for the dogs.  The camp sites are good size and most have great views.  We were able to walk across the park and rent a boat to take out on the lake for four hours.  We will definitely stay here again.

snippets.author: jenny couette
snippets.text: Very nice state park. Very large site. Sunset are beautiful. Staff are very nice and welcoming. Nice trail with cactus garden. Near everything by car or bike. Right on Lake Havasu and you see the London Bridge from the campground. Two points to complain. Showers have an annoying push button and only stays on for a few seconds and you have to keep pressing it and it took very long time to get warm and it is not realy warm, more cold than warm. We were there end of November and it is pretty cold in the morning till 10h and at night start to be cold at 5h PM, so It would have been nice to have a hot shower. Boats noice all day long to late at night and it is very loud but it is not state park fault. This is all I have to complain about. Hope to be back again.

snippets.author: Livelife
snippets.text:
Well maintained and very friendly. For 50 a night you get camp, water, eletric (that is yours), and there is a dump on sight (with potable water near by, it is next to street, away from dump, not the water at dump). There are big blue trash cans in the campgrounds (for  all campers to use).

The views are magnificent. There is a trail to the beach, a trail to watch sunset, trails to garden area... Its definitely worth the money.

Sports, kayaking, boating, swimming?? (It was to cold at beginning of December to test the swim).

Dinner-food, bring your own, have delivered (to gate), or go to one of the many places close by.

snippets.author: Megan R
snippets.text: The park itself is nice, as long as you don’t have to use the showers- I didn’t thankfully but I did look at them- they need an upgrade. The lake and scenery are perfect- the park was very clean- short beach walk and a 1.5 mile trail in the park- go to the top of the trail for sunset!

snippets.author: B. Maldonado
snippets.text:
This is a really great park in the heart of Lake Havasu City. Right on the water, beach access with covered picnic tables. Fantastic children's playgrounds, walking paths, and views of the lake.
Walking path that is great for wheelchairs all the way to the London Bridge.
Great area to view the hot air balloons from during the festival.

snippets.author: Gurl H
snippets.text:
Its very nice. Theyve got something for everyone.
Except me cuz i have dogs. Didnt see a single sign, but it is on the local web page ha i looked. Still, I spends evening walking around w my dogs waiting for te sunset. I asked about the beach, presuming no dgs,and got the only sarcastic response, making me question if id missd a sign. A few sideways glances confirmed I likely had, & headed back to my vehicle, noting one spot where no dogs was spray painted on a sidewalk.
The 4 stars is cuz dogs arent allowed vs 5, but still it is a very wll panned park that the locals are blessed to have. And n one shoed me out in spite of my egregious error of bringng 2 dogs to a no dogs allowed park. These days, that courtesy goes a long way.

snippets.author: Mamie Zembal
snippets.text: Beautiful place!! Clean bathroom, plenty of parking, benches and playground. Loved the replica lighthouses throughout. Enjoyed watching the sunrise and listening to the birds!

snippets.author: Bethany
snippets.text: Beautiful pet-free beach. You can have a lunch, kayak, have a beach day, walk around and see the shops. Plenty to do. We got inn-n-out and ate it for sunset at one of the pavilions. Wish we could have brought our dog but totally understand why its a pet free beach. It makes it enjoyable for all. Almost forgot, its also a bike-free zone. Mentioning it because there are signs but I still saw a teenager zooming on the sidewalk yelling people to move. There's always people who cant follow rules set for the safety of others, but just be alert with your kiddos.  Amazing free beach when so much is not free in today's world.

snippets.author: Julia Anna, Northland Gypsy
snippets.text: Rotary Community Park is a lovely spot on Lake Havasu. It's easy to launch a kayak from the sandy shore, and paddle 6 miles around the island. The Lake Havasu Paddlers meet every Monday, Wednesday and Friday morning at sunrise. Bring your own kayak.

snippets.author: Bridal Kaleidoscope
snippets.text: One the best campground we have been. Checking in was easy and young lady so so nice. Site was very clean with water and electricity hook up. Bathrooms very clean with showers. Nice beach and hiking trails. Even had a separate dog beach. Nice cactus garden and fruit trees! Everybody so nice.

snippets.author: Bethany
snippets.text: We had an amazing time at this state park. Spot 59 fit our 42 ft camper, squishy, but we fit. There are grills at each campsite, all sites are 30amp but 4 are 50 amp. Water & power at each site with a dump station upon leaving. Theres a human beach and a dog beach, hiking, kayaking, camping, & grilling. We had a wonderful time with beautiful scenic views for sunset. Highly recommended park!

snippets.author: Jamie Sturm
snippets.text:
Best place you stay max 14 days stay but well worth it
Clean well maintained bathrooms... hiking trails are great for every level of experience.. dog park with their own water area (not fully fenced) BUT your dog should be voice command training in high social areas! Plenty of dog walking areas on the levy and wash Run with pet stations! White sand beach for day use and a second beach for jet skiing and boats also only day use (remove your pop-ups.. cant save spots for next day first come first use) friendly kind staff and long term volunteers ... a cactus garden for a wonder walk ... and an amputheater (however you spell that lol)
Has a trade wall books for reading DVDs for viewing and puzzles for mind exercising... bring your horseshoes there is a pit
BOAT RAMP and parking (plenty)

snippets.author: Shamu Ed
snippets.text: What a cool vibe that was. So relaxing, just miles south of Havasu proper, noice chill zone before hitting Parker's festival of activities. Very and peaceful, loved the mini hike.

snippets.author: Pat Garner
snippets.text: This was our second time at Cattail Cove and we really enjoyed our visit. The campground is clean and well maintained. This park is absolutely dog friendly with many places to walk. We also hiked the McKinny loop. The rangers were friendly and helpful. We had good cell service. While it was very windy one day we still had a great time. Zero issues and would recommend for those who want to hike or enjoy the river.

name: Bill Williams River National Wildlife Refuge

snippets.author: Tiffany L.
snippets.text: Beautiful hidden gem. It's a nice nature walk surrounded by water  and great for all ages. The walk in the beginning is pretty standard. Once you reach the middle to the end it gets a little more challenging but definitely worth it.

snippets.author: Cory Fender
snippets.text: Beautiful! The trail isn't very long and some of it isn't paved but it's still totally worth it.

snippets.author: Katie Moore
snippets.text: A great stop to walk a paved path along the water. Path continues to gravel to reach the end of the peninsula. Good for kids with lots of info along the walkway. Nice opportunities to sit and contemplate and snap photos of the landscape.

snippets.author: Vanessa Montgomery
snippets.text: Very clean refuge and amazing Staff! Visitor Center is open Monday to Friday, closed on the weekends due to staffing. Yes, we need to pay FWS Staff more! Three fishing docks and three vault toilets in the Pennisular Trail; VTs are the cleanest we have ever seen! Beautiful area and 10 million dollar views of the Bill Williams River Delta!

snippets.author: Kate Montgomery
snippets.text:
Very nice location to go bird watching! If you have your own kayak or canoe, you can park and launch close to the marsh which has a great view of different ducks, gulls, and other birds.

- They offer guided hikes and education classes on certain dates.
- The fishing piers are accessible for wheelchairs.
- The bathrooms are very clean thanks to the wonderful volunteers!

snippets.author: Mamie Zembal
snippets.text:
Love hiking here! So many trails connect so you can choose your mix and match hike. Easy to tougher. I personally love the Crack which gets narrow and has a rope in which to drop down about 5 ft and then another boulder to scramble over. Trails are well marked and also several signs showing the trails and ratings. I always take a picture so I have on me.
A couple of different parking areas. The main one has nice bathrooms and a covered area with bench and table.

snippets.author: Good Vibez Garage
snippets.text: A great park to rip some discs. The holes are nice and open but offer great elevation changes. Be wary the large sharp rocks sliced up some of my softer plastics.

snippets.author: john vazquez
snippets.text: Great trails ranging from easy to very hard. There are great views of the lake. The "crack" is a fun trail, but not for those who get nervous by semi tight areas or can't climb up/down boulders.

snippets.author: Mikal Abdullah
snippets.text: 1st time to park. Lots of things to do. Watch a race car or motocross race, remote control airfield, shooting and archery ranges, lots of trails to hike and mountain bike!!

snippets.author: Katie Moore
snippets.text: Wonderful hike in Sara Park slot canyon trail (yellow trail) - fondly referred to as Sara’s Crack. Plenty of signage and trail markers. Folks get lost in this park every year so be sure to take lots of water even if you think you won’t be gone long. We hiked to the end of the slot and turned around to return the same way we came because we liked it so much. Beautiful both ways. Might want to do the Red Trail from the parking lot as it keeps you out of the sandy gravel for a large portion of the walk in.

snippets.author: Megan R
snippets.text: A very nice dog park, beautiful trees and walking path. 2 separate areas for large and small dogs. Some people don’t know how to pick up after their dogs- scoop the poop! That’s not the parks fault though- it’s well maintained otherwise.

snippets.author: Gurl H
snippets.text:
Its a nice, clean set of classic dog park(s)with a separate area for smaller dogs. Everyone there was quite nice & dogs were all well behaved.
I gave it 4 stars because the absolute best Dog Park is in Oakland County Michigan- it has Trails & a Dog Dock. If you ever pass thru there- your dog will love it.

snippets.author: Sally Ragusa
snippets.text: Nice size dog park.  Beautiful place along the water. Big trees with plenty of shade 😎

snippets.author: Alison Kramer
snippets.text: Nice, large, and clean dog park. Everyone that we encountered (people and dogs) were very friendly. There is a large and small enclosed dog park with plenty of dog bowls to get your dog a fresh cold drink. There are also kiddie pools in the large dog park. Shaded bench areas line each park along with plenty of lawn chairs to move around wherever you want to sit. Several huge shade trees are in each park. The parking area has plenty of parking and there are handicap spots as well. In front of the park there is a unisex bathroom. The park is located on the edge of town and there have been sightings of coyotes so keep a watchful eye on your dogs. Beautiful views in every direction, enjoy!

snippets.author: Victoria Guerra
snippets.text: Absolutely wonderful. I brought my four dogs and daughter there to check it out. I took one in at a time and happily was welcomed by people to attend regularly. Very clean area and has plenty of area for dogs to check out without feeling the need to confront each other. Definitely recommend.

snippets.author: Bill
snippets.text: Could be a great park if it weren't for the few people who treat everyone else like they own it. Took my small dogs here and after a couple minutes, a lady with 2 off leash large breeds known for being mean yelled at us saying "you're gonna wanna get those dogs outta there he doesn't like small dogs!" So if you have a large dog that doesn't like small dogs but you come here and see small dogs enjoying their time, take your big mean dog somewhere else. Completely unfair of anyone to expect accomodations to their inability to control their dog that they failed to train properly. Only got to enjoy the park for maybe five minutes because one stuck up c-word.

snippets.author: Jeff Leif
snippets.text: Great local park for a quick dog walk. We visited several times and watched many dogs running and playing.  The playground was busy with kids and families enjoying a warm evening.

snippets.author: Harry Smith
snippets.text: A very pleasant and well-maintained park, perfect for walking, picnicking, or simply relaxing outdoors. It has wide green spaces, walking paths, and a peaceful atmosphere to enjoy with family or friends. Great spot to unwind and connect with nature

snippets.author: Dawn Napier
snippets.text: Great experience. Great playground. Basketball court and goals available.  Dog park there too. Great place for a birthday party.

snippets.author: Roma Mugar
snippets.text: The Sara Park dog park is much better having separate areas for small and big dogs.

snippets.author: Shark School
snippets.text: Great local park honoring many loved ones from the area. The park is in great and well maintained condition, and the kids had lots of fun pretending in several areas of the play place. It’s a beautiful park!

snippets.author: The Gangsta Nun On The Run
snippets.text: Small, quiet, lazy park. Beautiful old trees, grassy spots in shade, pavilions, childs playground and plenty of parking. Lovely little park for a birthday party, picnic, a stroll and or a rest on a blanket on the grass. With all the trees it eliminates the echo of voices throughout the park making it enjoyable and peaceful.

snippets.author: Angelique Hoefl
snippets.text: Wonderful old trees and a shaded playground with shaded picnic tables. They have 4 swings (2 for toddlers and 2 for older kids). You can park direct in front of the park.

snippets.author: Neva Crawford
snippets.text:
Nice green park. Good area for playing Frisbee or ball with your dog. Lots of running room with no trees in the way.
Parking on two sides.

snippets.author: Matthew Serrano
snippets.text: An amazing park to walk your dogs on a leash!

snippets.author: Fred Shadid
snippets.text: Held a Veteran fundraiser booth on Bridgewater Links during Relics & Rods Run To The Sun, and as with everything connected to the prestigious London Bridge Resort it was an exemplary place. Beautifully landscaped with picturesque ponds and manicured lawn. And, if it couldn't get any better, I think I found my Titleist in the drink from days past. Lol

snippets.author: Chris Jessica Hailey Ella Shaske
snippets.text: Just finished nine holes at Bridgewater Golf Course in Lake Havasu, and it did not disappoint. The scenery is absolutely beautiful—mountains in the distance, blue skies overhead, and a well-kept course that makes every shot feel like a postcard moment. The facility is top-notch and super welcoming, perfect for a casual round or something a little more competitive. If you’re ever in the area and looking for a great spot to play, Bridgewater is definitely worth checking out.

snippets.author: Dirk
snippets.text: What a wonderful little gem of a course. Yes, it was 110 degrees out and yes it's only a 9 hole (who wants to play 18 in triple digits anyway??) but man was I pleasantly surprised by this place. It's just yards from the insanity of the canal, but you'd think you were nowhere near it.   Great value, beautiful course and extremely nice pro-shop. 👍

snippets.author: Fred Czarnetzki
snippets.text: Nice and clean, great classic car show, very friendly and courteous staff and the people showing of their beautiful classic cars were great, got some great pictures of their cars leaving the area at the end of the day  .

snippets.author: Nathan McDaniel
snippets.text: Fun Par 3 and 4's. It's a 9 hole course and it's actually really well kept and a fun not up tight golf course. The employees are very friendly and pleasant. My son and I had a great day visiting for the first time. We definitely will be back.

snippets.author: Megan R
snippets.text: A very fun trail! About 5 miles out and back. You can have different trail experiences going in and back too, we took the yellow trail / cracked rock in- a gorgeous slot canyon-and the blue trail- more elevation- back. Trails were well marked as of today!

snippets.author: Jeff Leif
snippets.text: Sara park has a wide variety of mixed-use trails. Some trails are easy,  fast and flowing, while others require close attention to loose rocks and changing trail conditions.  It is a great place to explore!

snippets.author: Adam Bostrom
snippets.text: This was a fun hike through the crack. I can imagine it wouldn't be fun in the heat of the summer but in November it was perfect. Took the hike all the way to the lake which ended up being a little over 5 miles out and back. My whole family was able to do it so it isn't a very difficult hike.

snippets.author: Kaja SWIEB
snippets.text: The trail is absolutely awesome, a little challenging but so rewarding. Beautiful views! Canyon is so much fun to explore. It could be out and back or loop it depends if you want to go through the canyon again. Big parking lot with bathroom at the trailhead.

snippets.author: chad gray
snippets.text: We did easy. Is it kinda the Crack they call it may be a little ruff on some one spot ya rope down a rock bout 5 feet heads up there.
